> The guide's own use of this number: it plays on teams with a Stability Score edge of 6 or more in non-conference games in weeks 0–3, and against teams scoring 0–6 in the same window, excluding games with a spread of 30 or more (pp. 40–41).

## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 30. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke opens with a joke that carries his argument: he made sure to double-check that Ohio State and Michigan did not move to the ACC before discussing Franklin. His assessment is three-part and unsparing — a solid motivator, a good recruiter, and a pretty lackluster in-game coach — but he immediately supplies the fit: the conference lacks premier teams right now, and this is a perfect landing spot. He sets out the record: just 8-7 in bowl games and 2-1 in the CFP, with a very high regular-season floor including two 9-4 seasons at Vanderbilt in the early 2010s when that was a rough job, and six double-digit winning seasons at Penn State. He adds that there is a lot of talent in the Hokies' pipeline and that Franklin, a southeastern PA native, should do very well recruiting in the DMV and the Keystone State. His conclusion is that this could be and should be a quick transformation.
